auxiliary_source_metrics.requested_non_no_op_count: oracle recomputed requested_non_no_op_count, retained as a source and standardized metric
auxiliary_source_metrics.total_planning_seconds: planning_latency_seconds, retained as source audit field
auxiliary_source_metrics.total_policy_response_seconds: policy_response_seconds, retained as source audit field

definitions.constraint_violation_rate: number of the cell's 60 ticks with constraint_violations > 0, divided by 60; zero violations yields 0.0
definitions.global_replan_count: oracle global_invocation_count; a non-NOOP global-scope invocation count
definitions.local_repair_count: oracle local_invocation_count; a non-NOOP local-scope invocation count, not effective local repair
definitions.response_time: planning_latency_seconds / max(1, planning_invocation_count); zero planned calls therefore retain a zero numerator and denominator 1

repeat_seed_note: For the three deterministic rule-based methods, repeated seed labels identify deterministic paired repeats rather than independent random seeds. This note does not characterize the learning methods.
